bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for certain energy efficiency projects in the city of Brainerd.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ENERGY EFFICIENCY PROJECTS; BRAINERD PUBLIC UTILITIES; APPROPRIATION.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $7,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Brainerd Public Utilities for energy efficiency projects. The appropriation under this section is available until expended.

(b) For purposes of this section, "energy efficiency project" includes but is not limited to:

(1) upgrades to existing turbine generators;

(2) replacing existing turbine generators with new units; or

(3) improvements to existing structures to accommodate new turbine generators.
additions: ENERGY EFFICIENCY PROJECTS; BRAINERD PUBLIC UTILITIES; APPROPRIATION.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $7,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Brainerd Public Utilities for energy efficiency projects. The appropriation under this section is available until expended.
(b) For purposes of this section, "energy efficiency project" includes but is not limited to:
(2) replacing existing turbine generators with new units; or
(3) improvements to existing structures to accommodate new turbine generators.
